# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

This is the µOS++ Framework project written in modern C++.

## Folder Structure

- `/src`: Contains the source code
- `/include`: Contains the header files
- `/tests`: Contains tests

## Coding Standards

- Use C++20 features
- Follow RTOS naming conventions
- Include instrumentation calls
- Handle error cases with proper return codes
- Use doxygen comments for documentation

## Language and style

- Use British English spelling and grammar.
- Use a professional tone.
- Prefer folder to directory.
